description: The image displays two pie charts illustrating the distribution of outcomes across different categories, likely from a study on generalization from atomic skills to complex reasoning tasks, as suggested by the paper title. The left pie chart, which appears to represent "Atomic Skill Fail" based on the legend, is divided into three segments: a large dark teal slice labeled 68.0%, a medium light blue slice labeled 12.0%, and a smaller white slice labeled 8.0%. The right pie chart, which appears to represent "Reason" based on the legend, is divided into four segments: a large light blue slice labeled 55.0%, a medium light gray slice labeled 21.0%, a smaller white slice labeled 14.0%, and a small dark teal slice labeled 10.0%. Both charts have percentage values directly labeled within their respective slices. A legend at the top indicates that the dark teal color corresponds to "Atomic Skill Fail" and the light blue color corresponds to "Correct," while the light gray color is associated with "Reason" (the full label is cut off). The charts are presented side-by-side, with the right chart appearing slightly larger.
